skills.name: Master of the Mountain (銘海の主)
skills.line: Mt. Suzuka is where I stand.
skills.description:
Exclusive effect.
SP Ootakemaru enters Soul-controlling form for 2 turns, increasing his RES by 100%. He gains a Mountain's Boon stack when an ally uses a special skill.
While in Soul-controlling form and when 3 or more non-summoned entities are KO'd, all buffs and control effects on SP Ootakemaru are removed. He then enters the Reincarnation form, increasing his SPD by 100 and damage reduction by 50%. While in the form, he also becomes immune to debuffs, control effects, Banish and similar effects. He automatically uses Obliterate Evils on his turns. ;Mountain's Boom (麓沢) : :'''Buff, Mark''': Max 4 stacks. Each stack reduced the onibi cost for Forgotten End. After using Forgotten End, all stacks are consumed.

upgrades.text: While in Soul-controlling form, damage received from single target attacks is decreased by 50%.
While in Soul-controlling form, when a non-summoned entity is KO'd he restores 30% of his max HP.
Duration of Soul-controlling state increases to 3 turns.
'''Upper Hand''': Automatically uses this skill at the start of battle.

skills.name: Obliterate Evils (逆魂尽断)
skills.description: SP Ootakemaru commands imps to launch a 5-strike attack to random enemies, dealing damage equal to 240% of his ATK with each strike.

skills.name: Forgotten End (断末無銘)
skills.line: Enemes of Mt. Suzuka, disappear now and be forgotten!
skills.description: SP Ootakemaru unleashes a wave of rocks to attack all enemies, dealing damage equal to 180% of his ATK. While he is in Soul-controlling form, also inflicts all enemies with Mountain's Erosion. ;Mountain's Erosion (麓蝕) : :'''Debuff, Status''': Overall ATK is reduced by 15% and healing effects are reduced by 30%. Converted into Mountain Crush after taking an action. ;Mountain's Crush (麓圧) : :'''Debuff, Mark''': Overall SPD is reduced by 30% and inflicts , lasts until the start of the next turn.
